verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Darius's Decimate while carrying heavy Hemorrhage stacks; you win if you save Facebreaker for a sandwich or step in during his Q windup.

brief.thesis: The lane hinges on cooldown windows, not raw stats: Darius's Apprehend is his only hard engage/peel tool and sits on a long 26-16s cooldown, while your Facebreaker only stuns when he's caught between two sides and merely slows him 1v1. Both kits punish overextension with true damage — his R scales off your bleed stacks, your W hits true damage in the center — which is exactly why this lands at a near-coinflip 50.5% over 210 games.

theirWindow.what: Back off from extended trading here: at 5 stacks he enrages for bonus attack damage, and his R (Noxian Guillotine) deals more true damage the more stacks you're carrying.

yourWindow.what: He's committed to the windup and can't cast E (Apprehend) to pull you out mid-swing — step in and land Q (Knuckle Down) or E (Facebreaker) for a free hit.

start.why: The dominant start here (49.6% win rate, 82.8% pick over 240 games); the extra AD and sustain trade evenly into Darius's Decimate poke and Hemorrhage bleed.

boots.why: Clear top pick (48.5% win rate, 74.2% pick over 196 games); the flat physical damage reduction blunts his autos, Crippling Strike hits, and Decimate swings.

core.why: First item in the most-played path (68.5% win rate, 35.3% pick over 54 games); its slow lets you stick through Darius's Crippling Strike slow and close gaps for E (Facebreaker).
Second in that same path; the armor shred and bonus health help you out-trade a Darius who's already shredding your armor with Apprehend's passive.
Completes the top build path; the bonus health directly counters Darius's true-damage Guillotine execute and scales your W (Haymaker) shield.

situational.when: you're ahead and need burst mitigation plus tenacity to survive his all-in
he's snowballing and you need raw health to soak Guillotine's true damage
the game goes long and you need cooldown reduction to loop your kit faster than his engage timers
he builds tanky and you need percent-health damage plus a slow to stop him disengaging

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking damage and healing rewards the extended trades this lane forces, and directly offsets the healing Darius gets from landing Decimate's blade edge on you.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick here (50.2% win rate, 95.7% pick); Ignite punishes the healing he gets off Decimate's blade edge and secures kills before his Guillotine cooldown resets.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: Apprehend sits on 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. Once he whiffs it or it's down, you have a long window to freely trade or all-in without fear of the pull.

playing.title: Trade during his Q windup
playing.detail: Decimate has a visible wind-up before the swing lands. Step in during that animation since he can't cancel it to cast Apprehend on you.

playing.title: Stay on the handle side
playing.detail: Decimate's blade (outer edge) deals more damage than the handle. If you're forced into range, hug close to him rather than standing at the rim.

playing.title: Facebreaker won't stun alone
playing.detail: E only stuns if Darius is caught between two sides — in a straight 1v1 it just slows him. Use minions, walls, or a jungler's arrival to convert it into a real stun.

playing.title: Bank Grit before committing
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) passively stores damage you take as Grit. Absorb a hit first, then cast it so the shield and true-damage burst land at full strength.

playing.title: Respect the Guillotine leap range
playing.detail: From level 6 on, his R leaps 460 range and deals true damage scaled by your bleed stacks. Don't sit low HP with stacks up inside that range.

playing.title: Use Q to close, not just to poke
playing.detail: Knuckle Down grants Move Speed toward champions on cast. Use that burst of speed to force the all-in before he can walk to a minion wave or his turret.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, item win rates, boots, runes, and summoner spell rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, stun conditions, and trade timing — is our own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Manage your ddistance well to avoid being pulled by Darius’s (E). Use [E] when Darius uses (Q) to gain the upper hand in combat.
